verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe a drop-in path for users of OpenAI's Python or Node.js SDKs: change the base URL to https://api.portkey.ai/v1 and use one Portkey API key to reach multiple providers. The docs also say this involves "adding Portkey-specific headers," so a change limited to only the base URL and key is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence that no extra headers are needed beyond base URL and key, a code example of OpenAI-compatible endpoint coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: Ideal for: if you’re currently utilizing OpenAI’s Python or Node.js SDKs. By changing the base URL and adding Portkey-specific headers, you can quickly integrate Portkey’s features into your existing setup.
The base URL for all REST API requests is `https://api.portkey.ai/v1`
one Portkey API key gives you access to multiple providers and models.
